evidence: unreadable: seg3:start — the caption 'the gap: 18' is printed directly on top of a gold '18%' readout which is itself sliced off by the bottom frame edge; two texts occupy the same pixels and neither resolves at arm's length.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:start the scene's gold value readout ('18%') is rendered in the same lower-third strip as the subtitle 'the gap: 18', overprinting it, and the digits are clipped by the bottom edge of the frame; by seg3:mid the readout has vanished behind the caption entirely.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The scale scene places its animated gap/value readout at a fixed low-frame y that overlaps the subtitle band's reserved zone and extends past the bottom safe area, so caption and readout collide instead of being stacked.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Move seg3's animated value readout out of the caption band: place the gap number above the fulcrum (between the two pans, around mid-frame) and keep the bottom ~18% of the frame reserved for the subtitle alone, so no number is ever printed under text or clipped by the frame edge.
